description: Compares a plan before and after a change and reports which finish dates move and which deadlines are newly met or missed. The change is a list of simple `changes` (move an item to a position, change effort, set or clear a deadline or a can't-start-before date, change a lane's people or availability, add a person or team, add a holiday, change working days, remove an item, change the start date), or an `alternative`: a whole changed copy of the plan, for anything else (moving work between people, splitting, cutting or adding items, dependencies, hand-offs, several changes at once). Returns the comparison and the changed plan. To apply a change and update the chart in one step, call show_plan with the same `changes` instead.

alternative.description: A changed copy of `plan`, in the same format, to compare against it. Items keep their name or id to be matched; `changes`, if also given, apply on top

date.description: Waiting on something external until this date; null clears it

availability.description: Percent of their working time available for this plan, 0-100. Default 100

id.description: Short id; defaults from the name

done.description: true: finished, takes no more time; false: back in the plan

lens.description: Which dates to show: planned = as estimated (default), likely 1.6×, safe bet 3.1×

plan.description: A whenship plan. Pass the current plan (from the chart or the last tool result) unchanged unless the user asked for changes

items.description: In priority order: earlier items get people first

dependsOn.description: Ids or names of items that must finish first

notBefore.description: Waiting on something external: cannot start before this date

who.description: Shorthand for one lane instead of `work`

work.description: Who does what. One entry per lane

after.description: Lane of another part of this item that must finish first (a hand-off)

days.description: Effort in working days of one person, exactly as the user estimated it

maxPeople.description: Teams only: most people who can work on this at the same time. Default 1

availability.description: Percent of their working time available for this plan, 0-100. Default 100

id.description: Short id; defaults from the name

start.description: First day of work. Default today

name: what_if
title: What if
